condition: auth_fetch must reject an IPv4-mapped IPv6 loopback URL after the URL parser canonicalizes its hostname
prerequisites: The caller supplies a literal mapped loopback URL to auth_fetch under the default restrictive URL policy; the browser navigation path is selected.
No DNS rebinding or attacker-controlled name resolution is involved.
safe: An ordinary public literal IPv4 HTTP(S) URL passes the restricted-address predicate without being mistaken for loopback
review: The tool passes url to navigateTo, which calls assertSafeUrl before page.goto. The upstream compare adds canonical mapped-address handling in the relevant private-address predicate. The fixed label covers this mapped-loopback condition, not all browser navigation, redirects, or future IP representations.
safe_prerequisites: Default restrictive URL policy; an ordinary public IPv4 HTTP(S) literal without redirects; the control concerns the URL predicate, not a successful browser response.
